name: Combat: odds show on every action, and the right tool for a shell says so
steps: EVAL:S.weapons.push('sledge'); S.weapon = 'sledge'; fight([spawn('saltback')], { close: true, back: ['map'] })
EVAL:S.fight = null; S.weapon = 'knife'; fight([spawn('saltback')], { close: true, back: ['map'] })

EXPECT:matchOf(spawn('saltback'), dtype('sledge')) === 1.5 && matchOf(spawn('saltback'), dtype('knife')) === 0.5 && matchOf(spawn('hound'), dtype('machete')) === 1.5 && matchOf(spawn('stinger'), dtype('shotgun')) === 1.5

name: Combat: a beast winds up a heavy move; dodge it, and it hits dirt, and you get an opening
steps: EVAL:fight([spawn('saltback')], { close: true, back: ['map'] }); S.fight.en[0].tele = { w: 'x', h: 'double claw', x: 2, acc: 10 }; go('fight')

name: Combat: a venomous bite poisons you, and Gut Glue cleans it out
steps: EVAL:S.hp = S.maxhp = 999; fight([spawn('stinger')], { close: true, back: ['map'] }); S.fight.en[0].tele = null; enemy()

name: Combat: Moe sells molotovs and Sprocket sells flares, and fire burns a swarm
Combat: shoot every beast's legs and running gets much easier
steps: EVAL:fight([spawn('hound')], { close: true, back: ['map'] }); globalThis.r0 = runP(); S.fight.en[0].lame = true

name: Early gear: tell Ma Thistle you're going past the fence and she gives you her third husband's zip gun and jacket
Rattle Gully: always known, hunt beasts for teeth, three hunts a day
steps: EVAL:globalThis.t0 = S.teeth; for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { go('town', 'gully'); cur.find(o => o && /Hunt/.test(o[0]))[1](); S.fight.en.forEach(e => (e.hp = 0)); enemy(); }

name: Combat: the harder the fight, the lower the chance to run
steps: EVAL:fight([spawn('gullyRat')], { back: ['map'] }); globalThis.r1 = runP(); S.fight = null
EVAL:fight([spawn('hound'), spawn('hound')], { back: ['map'] }); globalThis.r2 = runP(); S.fight = null
EVAL:fight([spawn('hiveMother'), spawn('stinger')], { back: ['map'] }); globalThis.r3 = runP(); S.fight.en[0].hp = 1; globalThis.r4 = runP()
EXPECT:r1 > r2 && r2 > r3 && r4 > r3
